notes.title: V1.1a now live!
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Mouse Cursor hidden on Bootstrap,
[*] Dismissing the Restart dialogue now returns you to the main menu,
[*] Fixed sign alignments,
[*] Fixed an issue where you could get inside the delivery. Don't think I broke anything else,
[*] Fixed a horrible timing judder on the reflections
[*] Fixed in-game Tilt shift 
[/list]

notes.title: A tiny patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where you couldn't enter levels sometimes
[*] Removed some incorrect debug text
[*] Tweaked some UI elements
[/list]

Let us know if you have any feedback on any levels - too easy? too hard? 

More levels are still coming!
